extension.description: Utilities for an Amlogic CoreELEC + Android internal dual-boot: sync Bluetooth remotes paired in Android over to CoreELEC (no re-pairing), choose which OS boots by default, and fix the WiFi MAC if CoreELEC shows a wrong/shared default. Generic to Amlogic CoreELEC boxes.
extension.news:
v1.1.2 - Fix: the CoreELEC update hook (user-update.sh) refused to restore the boot gate on some boxes, logging "cannot measure env_dualboot.bin (no stat, no ls+awk)". It sized the 64 KiB env image with stat/awk, which a box's OS-update initramfs may not have, so a healthy image read as unmeasurable and the gate was left stripped after an update. It now measures with dd + a shell test only -- tools every initramfs has -- so an OS update re-asserts the gate on every box. Run Repair once to refresh the bundled hook on disk.
v1.1.1 - Fix: the addon failed to start ("No module named 'envcodec'") because repair_core imported envcodec by bare name, which does not resolve when Kodi loads the addon as a package. Now falls back correctly in both Kodi and standalone/test contexts. Repair suite works again.
v1.1.0 - New: "Repair dual-boot install" -- one scan that checks the boot gate, the Dolby Vision module (dovi.ko), and the CoreELEC update hook, and fixes only what is stale. Keeps your default boot OS; does nothing if everything is already correct. - The old "Fix HDR/HLG playing in SDR" button is now part of Repair (the boot-gate check also covers HDR, the display resolution/refresh lock, and boot-switch integrity).
v1.0.2 - Bluetooth sync: do NOT enable BlueZ privacy. 1.0.1 made CoreELEC connect from a resolvable private address, which the remote never answers (link dies with 0x3e, no encryption). CoreELEC now connects from the public address the remote is bonded to -- as Android does. Running the sync removes 1.0.1's privacy config from a box that has it. - Bluetooth sync: warn before replacing a pairing CoreELEC already has, and offer to prove the imported keys work (connect + encrypt) instead of leaving a remote that flaps forever.
v1.0.1 - New: "Fix HDR/HLG playing in SDR" -- rewrites the boot gate of an install made before the hdmitx= fix, so eMMC-booted CoreELEC stops tonemapping HDR10/HLG to SDR. Keeps the default boot OS; does nothing if the gate is already correct. - Bluetooth sync: adopt Android's BLE identity (local IRK + privacy), not just the device bonds, so remotes paired in Android actually reconnect in CoreELEC. - Bluetooth sync: stop bluetoothd before writing its store, and make sure the adapter comes back powered afterwards (a restart could leave the controller off, i.e. "no Bluetooth adapter").
v1.0.0 - Initial release: Bluetooth remote sync from Android, default boot OS, WiFi MAC fix.
